# Swachh Campus - NIT Patna Waste Bin Locator & Sanitation Management
> Official Digital Portal under Swachh Bharat Mission (Urban), Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs (MoHUA), Government of India.
> Operational Institution: National Institute of Technology Patna (NIT Patna), Ashok Rajpath, Patna, Bihar - 800005, India.

## Institutional Purpose
Swachh Campus is a digital campus utility facilitating 100% source segregation of municipal solid waste across the Ashok Rajpath campus of NIT Patna. It provides interactive geospatial bin location, nearest dustbin distance routing, real-time overflow complaint logging, offline-first sync with Supabase PostgreSQL, and official Swachhata pledge certification.

## Canonical Domain & Route Slugs
- Primary Portal: https://swachh.nitp.ac.in/
- Interactive Campus Map: https://swachh.nitp.ac.in/map
- Nearest Dustbin Finder: https://swachh.nitp.ac.in/finder
- Segregation Handbook & 3D Rules: https://swachh.nitp.ac.in/guide
- Sanitation Grievances & Command Desk: https://swachh.nitp.ac.in/alerts
- Official Swachhata Pledge: https://swachh.nitp.ac.in/pledge

## Campus Location & Coordinates
- Latitude: 25.6207° N
- Longitude: 85.1727° E
- Campus Area: Main Campus on the south bank of River Ganga, Ashok Rajpath, Mahendru, Patna 800005.

## Waste Categorization Standards (MoHUA Compliance)
1. Green Bin (Wet / Biodegradable Waste):
   - Food leftovers, vegetable peels, canteen kitchen scraps, fruit waste, tea leaves, garden cuttings.
   - Destination: Campus aerobic composting pits near Ganga Ghat perimeter.
2. Blue Bin (Dry / Recyclable Waste):
   - Paper, examination booklets, cardboard boxes, PET plastic bottles, beverage cans, clean packaging film.
   - Destination: Material Recovery Facility (MRF) for recycling partnerships.
3. Yellow / Sanitary Bin (Hazardous & Medical Waste):
   - Chemistry laboratory chemical absorbent pads, dispensary gloves, sanitary napkins, biomedical swabs.
   - Destination: Authorized municipal hazardous waste treatment incinerator.
4. Red Bin (E-Waste):
   - Damaged computer peripherals, PCB boards, discarded cables, depleted batteries.
   - Destination: State Pollution Control Board authorized recycler.

## Key Campus Sectors

- New Incubation Centre & Campus Sports Pavilion

## Civic Sanitation Reporting Flow
1. Campus community members scan the QR placard on any dustbin or click "Report Bin Overflow".
2. Incident is tagged with bin ID, issue category (Overflowing, Wrong Segregation, Damaged Bin, Unclean Area), and optional photo.
3. Ticket synchronizes instantly with PostgreSQL / local storage.
4. SBM Estate Sanitation Squad dispatches cleaning personnel within 30 minutes.
5. On completion, ticket status changes to Resolved and bin fill reset to 5%.
